name: Joyner Blueberry Farm and Nursery
description: Joyner Blueberry Farm and Nursery is a family-run berry farm in Belews Creek, NC. It grows Blueberries, with picking through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
